title: anthyllis vulneraria subsp. praepropera
intro: Anthyllis vulneraria subsp. praepropera, commonly known as Kidney Vetch or Spring Kidney Vetch, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the legume family, Fabaceae. It is valued for its potential health benefits, including its ability to support kidney and urinary system function, as well as its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Anthyllis vulneraria subsp. praepropera are attributed to its ability to stimulate diuresis, reduce swelling, and protect against oxidative stress, making it a potential natural remedy for conditions such as urinary tract infections and kidney stones. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its therapeutic effects.
